Create one new ORIGINAL game sprite atlas for the supplied character reference, for an offline 2D side-view platform fighter. The reference sheet locks face, clothes, skin, props and inked warm cel-shaded style. Do not include its parchment, title, frame numbers or backgrounds.
A genuinely transparent PNG canvas with exactly SIX equally sized cells arranged in 3 columns and 2 rows, all cells on a uniform grid, no panel dividers or text. Every pose is the same full-body character FACING RIGHT, no weapons beyond the named primary prop, clean strong dark outline, compact exaggerated 4.5-head cartoon proportions and simplified readable shading. Hold all feet/props inside each cell with generous transparent margins; identical approximate height and feet baseline in each cell. No cast background shadow, no scenery, no glow. This is a sprite atlas, not a printed model sheet. All six poses consistent in face/costume. Character David, blue scarf, russet tunic, curly black hair, brown skin, sling and stone pouch. Six cells left to right then next row: 1 ready idle with sling; 2 running with left leg forward; 3 running with right leg forward; 4 airborne jump with bent knees; 5 quick forward sling release, forward arm extended, no detached projectile painted; 6 heavy overhead sling windup, planted wide stance. Short cloth motion and no projectile traces. Transparent background.
